column2: Volt set the scooter's clock right before this test, so the scooter may not be keeping the time it's given. Until that's solved, a smart plug is a safer timer. Report an issue with diagnostics so we can look into it.

column4: Volt set the clock on the scooter right before this test, so the scooter perhaps does not keep the time it gets. Until that is resolved, a smart plug is a safer timer switch. Use "Report a problem" and include diagnostics, so we can look at it.
